question: Who launched the Capacity Building Plan (CBP) for Government Employees in September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr Jitendra Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr Jitendra Singh** launched the Capacity Building Plan (CBP) for Government Employees in September 2023.
 
• The Capacity Building Plan aims to enhance the skills and competencies of government employees to improve their efficiency and effectiveness in public service delivery.
 
• It is part of the government's broader initiative to reform and modernize the public administration system.
 
• Dr Jitendra Singh emphasized the importance of continuous learning and development for government employees to adapt to the changing administrative landscape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Capacity Building Plan is aligned with the National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB) - "Mission Karmayogi".
 
• It focuses on the development of domain knowledge, functional skills, and behavioral competencies of government employees.
 
• The plan includes various training modules, workshops, and e-learning courses tailored to the needs of different departments and roles within the government.
 
• Dr Jitendra Singh is the Minister of State for Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, and has been actively involved in various initiatives aimed at administrative reforms and capacity building.
